messages:
dana: FYI partner reported a ""billing spike"" for yesterday. their hourly snapshot shows +14k embed credits at 15:00 local, but our consolidated ledger only has +7k. looks like duplication or partial replay. anyone know their replay semantics?

rafael: they mentioned they do a ""replay-if-missing"" from devices which can resend entire hour batches. if we don't have idempotency keys we can double-count.

yuki: do they include any request_id or event_uuid in the payload? need that to de-dupe.

april: partner payload sample from support ticket: ```
{"hour":"2026-04-02T15:00:00-04:00","meter":"partner.embed","units":7000}
``` no id anywhere. they said their gateway strips headers for privacy.

corey: gah. so they send hourly aggregates and then occasionally resend the same aggregate with the same hour. our ingestion currently upserts into partner_hourly using (partner_id, hour, meter) as a key but series of race conditions allow duplicate rows when concurrent writes collide -> we then aggregate and sum duplicates.

rafael: suggested safe change last quarter was to treat incoming aggregate payloads as authoritative: replace instead of add. but some partners expect additive semantics (they stream deltas). we need per-partner contract field: ""aggregate_mode"": [""replace"",""add""] default = ""replace"".

dana: replacement mode would solve replay doubles. but we must cover partners that want add. for them we require an idempotency token or include a monotonic sequence number.

yuki: implementation sketch: 1) webhook schema add optional fields: idempotency_key, sequence_number, aggregate_mode. 2) ingestion path: if aggregate_mode=="replace" then upsert with set units = incoming; if aggregate_mode=="add" and idempotency_key present then dedupe on idempotency_key, otherwise reject with 422 and a diagnostics header.

april: ops question: what about late-arriving partial replays where the partner resends a corrected aggregate with smaller units? replace would accept the correction, add would double-count unless they send idempotency_key. we should also expose a replay_reason in the contract for visibility.

corey: agree. plus we need a reconciliation alert: when partner_hourly delta between our snapshot and their reported snapshot > 1% for any hour, open a ticket in #partnerships-recon with CSV attached. marketplace-bot: can we wire that?

marketplace-bot: scheduled job ""partner-hourly-compare"" configured: run every 15m. will post summary + attach CSV when discrepancy > 1%. next run in 12m.

rafael: also add a migration plan. For existing partners that currently send aggregates without keys, we should opt them into replace mode by default and notify them. For those who explicitly want additive semantics, we require them to send keys within 30 days or we will enforce reject.

dana: can someone draft the partner notice? I can loop in legal for contract amendment. we should include examples and a troubleshooting playbook (how to handle late replays, DST, partial hours).

yuki: i'll draft the technical spec PR for the webhook schema and ingestion changes. includes SQL migration for converting duplicate rows into single canonical rows:```sql
WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT partner_id, hour, meter, max(units) as canonical_units
  FROM partner_hourly
  GROUP BY partner_id, hour, meter
)
UPDATE partner_hourly p
SET units = d.canonical_units
FROM dedup d
WHERE p.partner_id = d.partner_id AND p.hour = d.hour AND p.meter = d.meter;
``` mark: this is conservative - choose max to preserve reported value, open to other heuristics.

april: note for partners who send both raw events and hourly aggregates: we need clear precedence rules. recommended: prefer raw events -> recompute hourly snapshot -> ignore aggregate for that hour unless aggregates are flagged authoritative. add field ""authoritative_source"": [""events"",""aggregate""] per partner.

corey: ops: i will add a short circuit in the hourly reconcile to prefer authoritative_source if configured and surface a warning if both arrive for same hour.

dana: timeline?

yuki: spec PR today, schema PR tomorrow, marketplace-bot rule live by EOD if no objections.

rafael: i'll prepare the partner-facing email template and migration window (30 days). dana loop legal and account execs.

april: will add runbook steps to the partner-metering playbook.

corey: i'll also add a small integration test into the hourly ingestion job that simulates duplicate aggregate replays and ensures replace/add semantics behave.

marketplace-bot: alert: partner-hourly-compare run completed. partner=edgebox-inc hour=2026-04-02T15:00:00-04:00 discrepancy=34% -> CSV attached to ticket #PART-891.

dana: thanks all. follow-ups: @yuki spec PR, @rafael partner comms, @corey reconcile alert wiring, @april runbook. I'll post final action list after legal ack.
